passages.context: Sections 47-49 were read in sequence with the end of section 46 and the chapter 9 synopsis. Ambrose contrasts manna, whose eaters died, with the living Bread from heaven, identifies the received food as Christ's Body, and contrasts figure or shadow with the giver's Body. The verification controls this English witness only.
